rounds.text: The current valuation of Jubilant Agri & Consumer Products Ltd appears disconnected from its underlying financial reality, as the stock trades at a significant premium to its book value at 7.23x [E2] and 7.75x against a sector benchmark of only 1.84x [E7]. This aggressive pricing is further challenged by a discounted cash flow analysis that suggests an intrinsic value of ₹ 1,961, leaving the current market price with a negative margin of safety of -12.1% [E35, E36]. Investors are paying for high growth expectations, as the stock’s current price implies an earnings growth rate of 11.6%, which exceeds the base case assumption of 10.0% [E37]. Furthermore, the company’s cash conversion is concerning at 0.59x, indicating that reported profits are significantly outpacing actual cash generation [E23]. While the company has demonstrated strong historical profitability, the recent trend shows inconsistent operating margins [E21, E22] and a decline in quarterly margins [E20]. Conceded: the company maintains a strong return on equity [E13, E17] and has successfully reduced its debt levels [E29, E49].
